insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹8L–₹15L referenced for optional cover)

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; proportionate deduction applies on associate medical expenses if higher room opted

icu.note: ICU/ICCU including intensivist, monitor and pulse oxymeter charges capped at 2% of SI per day

copayment.display: 20% if Zone 2 insured treated in Zone 1
copayment.note: 20% co-pay applies only when insured opts Zone 2 (Rest of India) and gets treated in Zone 1 (Maharashtra & Gujarat). No co-pay for accidents or sub-limited treatments.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, modern treatments, mental illness, ARMD, genetic disorders capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI or ₹50k whichever less; modern treatments: 10–50% of SI with ₹cap; mental illness: 25% of SI; ARMD: 10% of SI up to ₹75k; genetic disorders: 25% of SI; artificial life support: 10% of SI up to 15 days; puberty/menopause: 25% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months continuous coverage; reducible via portability credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, calculi, benign tumours etc.; 36-month wait for joint replacement, ARMD, mental illness, genetic disorders, external congenital diseases; 90-day wait for diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases 25% per claim-free year up to max 50%; reduced at same rate if claim made; option to take premium discount instead

restoration.note: No restoration/reinstatement benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days preceding hospitalisation

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge

day_care.note: Annexure I lists 226 specific day care procedures covered

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under clause 4.4.17

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered (excluding cost of organ) up to recipient's Sum Insured

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges covered up to 1% of Sum Insured per insured event for emergency/ICU admission or inter-hospital transfer

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered with individual sub-limits ranging from 10% to 50% of SI with absolute ₹ caps (e.g. robotic surgery up to 50% of SI/₹5L, oral chemo up to 10% of SI/₹1L)

consumables.note: Consumables like gloves, ECG electrodes, masks etc. are in List I (not payable); some subsumed into room/procedure charges

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment only within India; treatment outside India explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary treatment, overseas treatment, acupressure/acupuncture, external prosthetics/hearing aids, CPAP/BIPAP/home equipment, vaccination, OPD procedures converted to IP

optional_riders.display: Enhanced cataract limit (₹80k–₹1.5L for SI ₹8L–₹15L, 36mo wait)
